# Owned Surface Material Transport Fixtures

These small scenes are project-authored under GPL-3.0-only. The render test stages
owned synthetic tensor and SCATFUN tables; they are format and transport fixtures,
not measurements of real materials. Every scene contains a finite emitter and an
environment. The mix scene includes mapped roughness, a child bump field, and a
child normal map so endpoint binding can be compared with direct child binding.

`normal-tilted.png` is the unchanged owned core-texture fixture from
`../core-textures/assets/normal-tilted.png`, generated by that fixture's
`generate_assets.py`. No external scene assets are copied or converted.
